About this Event

This October, the doors to the haveli are opening… and once the music starts, there’s no telling what might follow you onto the dance floor. 👻🔥

Mehfil Moments Entertainment presents BOLLYWEEN — DARNA MANA HAI! A spooky Bollywood night filled with music, hookah, dancing, costumes, and late-night Halloween vibes. 🕷️💀

🎃 FRIDAY, OCTOBER 30
🚪 Lounge opens at 5 PM
🎧 DJ starts at 9 PM ’til dead
💃 Belly Dancer — Every Friday Night
👻 Costume Contest — come dressed to K*ll!
💨 Hookahs • Drinks • Music • Dancing
🎟️ $10 Cover
📍 Kush Hookah Lounge & Bar
278 Mid Rivers Center, St. Peters, MO 63376

⚠️Darna Mana Hai… but costumes are encouraged.
Come for the party. Stay for the haunting. 🩸
